label: დილის {n} ამბავი
about: The Morning Digest: 2-3 stories that already passed their checks, in one 45-60 s video; code joins their first sentences into one narration (no writer) with a chapter card per story, and the result is checked again.
brief: No writer: tt_shorts/digest.py builds it from the stories' narrations (their first sentences, up to the outlets line).
Each story keeps its own checked scenes whose first words fall in the sentences taken.
